timeline.labelEn: Zampern (zapust), the Sorbian Shrovetide custom that drives out winter, photographed in Klein Schauen, Lusatia

questions.notes: Multiple-choice card reworked to an open question. Zapust (Zampern) is a Sorbian Shrovetide custom in Lusatia meant to drive out winter. The custom has no datable origin (pre-Christian roots); the timeline uses the 1955 photograph on the source page.

timeline.labelDe: Eine Studie zeigt, dass die weit auseinanderliegenden Augen der Hammerhaie ihnen einen Rundumblick von 360° in der Vertikalen geben

questions.notes: Multiple-choice card reworked to an open question. Apitherapy is the pseudomedical use of bee products (propolis, bee venom, honey, hive air, pollen, royal jelly). The 1888 Terč date is from en.wikipedia 'Apitherapy'.
